title: 手绘小巷地图  (The Illustrated Map Gift)

segments.t: Beneath the old shade tree, Zhou and Mei untie the twine on the flat brown parcel at table one while Qing steps forward to read the hoarse mapmaker's handwritten toast card aloud to the smiling neighbours. Listen first.
梧桐巷的各位朋友，原谅我坐长途火车嗓子累了，请小晴替我道声谢。
小晴，念大声清楚点儿，好让水池那头后排的桌子也听见！
三十个五月前，一场连阴雨把一位年轻旅人留在了八号房。
正好就是您姑姑端出热茶、带着大家在阳光房跳华尔兹的那一星期！
听着：我画了三十年大城市，可世上再没有比这儿更暖心的地方。
小美，数到三跟我一块儿揭开牛皮包装纸——一、二、三！
哇！快看这个胡桃木画框——是一幅大号的手绘梧桐巷地图！
这儿有石喷泉、钟楼、书店拱门，还有公园长椅！
正中央用暖暖的金箔画着的，就是咱们小院客栈和九号房！
看他在咱们院子里画的小人儿——居然还有人把眼镜推在额头上呢！
喂！大门口那位气宇轩昂的绅士长得可真体面，多谢夸奖啊！
咱们把这张地图挂在九号挂钩旁边，让每位旅人都不迷路！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
梧桐巷的各位朋友，原谅我坐长途火车嗓子累了，请小晴替我道声谢。
'Friends of Wutong Lane, forgive my tired train-ride voice and let Qing share my thanks.' "Ti wo" means "in my place" or "for me", while "dao sheng xie" politely means "offer a word of thanks".
小晴，念大声清楚点儿，好让水池那头后排的桌子也听见！
'Read loud and clear, Qing, so the back tables over by the fountain basin hear too!' Zhou uses "hao rang" ("so that...") to carry Qing's voice all the way back to "shuichi" ("fountain basin").
三十个五月前，一场连阴雨把一位年轻旅人留在了八号房。
'Thirty Mays ago, a rainy week kept a young traveler tucked inside Room Eight.' "Lian yinyu" describes a stretch of "continuous overcast rain", counted with "chang" for weather spells.
正好就是您姑姑端出热茶、带着大家在阳光房跳华尔兹的那一星期！
'That was the very week your aunt brought out hot tea and started the sunroom waltz!' "Zhenghao jiushi" locks onto "that exact moment", while "huaerzi" brings "waltz" into Mandarin by sound.
听着：我画了三十年大城市，可世上再没有比这儿更暖心的地方。

'Listen: I spent thirty years mapping great cities, yet no place on earth ever felt warmer than here.' "Nuanxin" pairs "warm" and "heart" for "heartwarming", boosted by "zai meiyou bi ... geng" ("nothing more ... than").
小美，数到三跟我一块儿揭开牛皮包装纸——一、二、三！
'Lift away the brown wrapping paper with me on three, Mei—one, two, three!' "Shu dao san" sets the cue "count to three", and "jiekai" means "peel back" or "unveil".
哇！快看这个胡桃木画框——是一幅大号的手绘梧桐巷地图！
'Oh! Look at that walnut frame—it is a giant hand-painted map of Wutong Lane!' "Shouhui" joins "hand" and "draw" for "hand-painted", counted as a flat artwork with "fu".
这儿有石喷泉、钟楼、书店拱门，还有公园长椅！

'There is the stone fountain, the clock tower, the bookshop arch, and the park bench!' "Shi penquan" combines "stone" with "spray spring" for "stone fountain", beside "changyi" ("long chair" = "bench").
正中央用暖暖的金箔画着的，就是咱们小院客栈和九号房！
'And right in the center, painted in warm gold leaf, sits Courtyard Inn and Room Nine!' "Zheng zhongyang" pins down "dead center", gleaming with "jinbo" ("gold foil / gold leaf").
看他在咱们院子里画的小人儿——居然还有人把眼镜推在额头上呢！

'Look at the tiny figures he painted in our courtyard—one even has glasses perched on his forehead!' "Xiaorenr" adds the friendly "-r" ending to "little people" for "tiny painted figures", and "juran" highlights Mei's amused surprise.
喂！大门口那位气宇轩昂的绅士长得可真体面，多谢夸奖啊！

'Hey! That distinguished gentleman by the gate looks remarkably handsome, thank you very much!' "Timian" means "dignified" or "presentable", and "duoxie kuajiang" playfully accepts a compliment Zhou invented himself.
咱们把这张地图挂在九号挂钩旁边，让每位旅人都不迷路！
'Let us hang this map right beside hook number nine so no traveler ever loses their way!' "Guagou" names a wall "hook", while "bu milu" pairs "not" with "lose the road" for "never get lost".
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
梧桐巷的各位朋友，原谅我坐长途火车嗓子累了，请小晴替我道声谢。
小晴，念大声清楚点儿，好让水池那头后排的桌子也听见！
三十个五月前，一场连阴雨把一位年轻旅人留在了八号房。
正好就是您姑姑端出热茶、带着大家在阳光房跳华尔兹的那一星期！
听着：我画了三十年大城市，可世上再没有比这儿更暖心的地方。
小美，数到三跟我一块儿揭开牛皮包装纸——一、二、三！
哇！快看这个胡桃木画框——是一幅大号的手绘梧桐巷地图！
这儿有石喷泉、钟楼、书店拱门，还有公园长椅！
正中央用暖暖的金箔画着的，就是咱们小院客栈和九号房！
看他在咱们院子里画的小人儿——居然还有人把眼镜推在额头上呢！
喂！大门口那位气宇轩昂的绅士长得可真体面，多谢夸奖啊！
咱们把这张地图挂在九号挂钩旁边，让每位旅人都不迷路！
Painted in watercolor and gold leaf, Wutong Lane and Courtyard Inn shine inside a walnut frame—complete with tiny forehead glasses! See you next time.
